subject: Noxus town visual contract: site plan, construction states, click geometry, adventure objects, siege and visual direction.
derivation: 27 October from-scratch painted2D terrain/composition rebuild around complete silhouette envelopes; all36 valid painted building masters deliberately reused unchanged. Existing19 functional sites retained, including17 ordinary land, coast and Grail. Seven dwelling families retain one site each.

canvas.reference: the native Heroes III town canvas used by the Castle faction
canvas.layerModel: Every structure is authored as a full-canvas layer with an area mask and a border mask. Masks, not hand-tuned rectangles, define the clickable geometry, so a painted layer can be replaced without editing configuration.
canvas.currentState: New painted2D Noxian city backdrop/composition with three targeted imagegen passes, full native silhouette planning before painting and exact compiler scene comparison. Source appearance inspected; native and release acceptance remain separate.

siteGroupingNote: Nineteen visual sites hold the thirty-six authored building states. The Binding Vault, the Rift of Ruin and the Greater Binding Rift are three states of one site, because dwellingLvl7 declares "upgrades": "special4" and VCMI replaces an upgraded building in place. The site count is a design grouping; the state count comes from the authored building graph.

adventureObjects.mapStateRule: One animation per state in the own namespace, matching the five fortification and hall stages.

puzzle.rule: A 48-piece native puzzle map, each piece an own artwork in the Noxus namespace.

siege.shooterRule: The tier three axe Reckoner is the siege shooter of the town, so the siege screen shows the Reckoner on the walls instead of a generic archer.
siege.wallRule: The walls and towers keep the native Heroes III fortification grammar, repainted in the Noxian palette, so that a Noxus siege is readable to an original-game player.

visualDirection.style: Original Heroes III Castle native painted compatibility: the same rendering language, canvas and readability, with independently designed Noxian subjects.
visualDirection.palette: Iron grey, dark red stone, crimson accents, bleached bone, black cloth. No purple-and-gold imperial cliché that would read as another faction.
visualDirection.architecture: Utilitarian imperial engineering, arena and garrison imagery, the Black Rose as a secretive rather than decorative motif.
visualDirection.prohibitions: No copied original troop or town art, no renamed or recoloured Demacia layer, no placeholder rectangles presented as finished art, and no use of original sprite pixels beyond the measured layout reference.

assetBinding.currentState: All required outputs are missing. The town is therefore a configuration, not a visible town.

site_budget_reason: The existing Noxus graph retains independent required military and public services; no functions hidden or removed to imitate another faction's count.
native_visual_acceptance: Pending current-build normal native town/click observation; source pixels and real compiler outputs inspected separately.
composition_constraints: Enlarged rear civic/bastion/binding landmarks, organic central curved avenue, continuous dry door aprons, no foreground retaining faces, charcoal/cinder urban floor, distant crimson smoky fortress city. Background has no invented crest marks; existing physical correct crests on functional buildings remain.
